reviewer: Claude Code (cast session for #774), from the stream-json transcript, the served-request log and the agent's notes
rule: An intervention is an action on the project or its tooling that the guidance or CLI output did not print or link. A decision is a choice about setting up, theming or styling with Ultima that the guidance did not settle and that changed the output; product choices the brief leaves open (data, copy, arrangement, Select or Dialog) and choices between documented options are not counted. Writing a browser script for the production check the install page asks for follows the guidance.

interventions.action: Rendered /install, /build-a-screen and /support with headless Chromium (--dump-dom) and pulled lesson source out of the Code tabs' download links.
interventions.reason: The linked docs pages render client-side, so a plain HTTP fetch returns an empty shell.

decisions.choice: Kept @stylexjs/eslint-plugin 0.19.1 over init's 0.19.0 runtime instead of doctor's ULT-LINT-003 repair
options: 0.19.0 plugin (2 valid-styles errors in installed select.tsx)
decisions.why: init, the lint walkthrough and doctor disagree on the StyleX version.

decisions.choice: Dropped init's colorScheme.system style from the screen root
decisions.why: On a subtree, colorScheme.system follows the OS even when data-theme pins a mode; the guidance does not say what to do with init's preview style once a theme is applied.
